sigma_rule:
title: Hunt - Adversary may use PowerShell with encoded commands
id: cbfed1fd-b291-4489-afd0-b9f62fd42677
status: experimental
description: Adversary may use PowerShell with encoded commands
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'powershell'
            - 'cmd'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative activity
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.execution
